title: The Famine Corridor
logline: When a shipping cartel cuts off hydroponic supplies to a rebellious border sector, an independent logistics broker hires a blockade runner to restart the grain run.

roles.description: A retired merchant marine captain running an illegal relief pipeline from a neutral border waystation.
Commander of the shipping consortium's armed blockade flotilla; cold, legalistic, enforcing financial sanctions.
Head of the triage committee on the starving mining habitats; overworked, pragmatic, and desperate for bulk calories.
The dominant logistics conglomerate enforcing a total debt embargo against non-compliant systems.
An unrecognised confederation of outer mining stations facing starvation over unpaid transport tariffs.
A freeport station situated just outside the embargo perimeter, packed with impounded grain barges.
A crowded mining settlement on the edge of the dark zone where life support and food rations have failed.
A heavy patrol gunboat guarding the gate corridor into the embargoed system.

public_situation: The {role:shipping_consortium} has locked down transit gates into the outer rim, cutting food deliveries until the mining stations pay delinquent tariffs.
private_truth: The embargo was declared to force the miners to forfeit their private ore charters to the consortium, using engineered starvation as debt leverage.

beats.public_change: Food riots erupt across border gates as merchant haulers are turned back by consortium enforcers.

missions.reason: The broker needs emergency medical supplements and freeze-dried yeast bought from local markets and staged at the neutral freeport.
missions.private_fact: The broker lost his own brother to a corporate famine thirty years ago and will bankrupt himself before letting this sector starve.

beats.public_change: The consortium moves armed gunboats into the gate transit lanes, threatening to impound any vessel carrying unchartered provisions.

missions.reason: The habitat's hydroponics need raw water ice hauled immediately from deep comet belts to restart the wilted algae scrubbers.
missions.private_fact: The habitat council has already drafted a surrender petition, ready to sign over their mines if water does not arrive within forty-eight hours.

missions.reason: The broker pays the pilot to destroy the picket ship blocking the approach lane so unescorted relief haulers can jump through.
missions.private_fact: The picket crew is operating under private mercenary contracts with bounty clauses for every captured relief hauler.

beats.public_change: With the picket broken, consortium headquarters sends an armed escort to seize the grain barges at the freeport dock.

missions.reason: The coordinator asks the pilot to courier emergency baby formula and protein concentrates directly to the habitat clinic docks.
missions.private_fact: The coordinator is secretly rationing meals to children only while hospital staff survive on saline drips.

beats.public_change: The commodore realizes military force has failed to stop the runs and offers a diplomatic truce at the border gate.

missions.reason: The broker asks the pilot to scan the consortium's intercepted logistics transmissions to verify if the truce terms are genuine or an ambush.
missions.private_fact: The transmissions reveal the consortium's shareholders are panic-selling stock due to the public relations disaster of the famine.

beats.public_change: The commodore docks at the neutral depot to present an ultimatum to the assembled station delegates.

missions.reason: The broker needs the pilot to deliver the ratified treaty documents to the treaty table before privateer skirmishes resume.
missions.private_fact: The commodore's personal flagship is low on fuel and cannot maintain the blockade for more than three more days.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the treaty council with the food supply lines open. The commodore offers a compromised settlement, while the miners demand complete debt cancellation.

options.label: Deliver the terms guaranteeing permanent free trade and breaking the embargo
Support the consortium's compromise amnesty in exchange for miner debt restructuring
Surrender the broker's supply chain routes to the commodore for private reward

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the treaty breaking the embargo.
resolutions.summary: The food blockade collapses; {role:miner_republic} secures permanent free transit rights while {role:shipping_consortium} loses its monopoly.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke the shipping cartel's grip and hauled grain into the starving rim.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot supports the compromise amnesty.
resolutions.summary: {role:shipping_consortium} resumes grain shipments under heavy tariffs, while {role:miner_republic} remains burdened by twenty years of restructured debt.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells out the supply routes to the commodore.
resolutions.summary: {role:blockade_broker} is arrested as an outlaw runner; {role:shipping_consortium} seizes the mining outposts and claims complete regional ownership.

resolutions.reached_by: The relief deliveries fail or the pilot never gets involved.
resolutions.summary: The blockade holds until {role:miner_republic} capitulates; {role:blockade_broker} is executed for sedition and the mines are forfeit.

loose_threads.detail: Cartel bond issuances offered triple yield contingent on foreclosing the border mining charters before quarter end.
The picket gunboat's hull bears welded-over registry plates from an independent logistics registry.

radio_hooks: Bread lines stretch for kilometers through {system} as shipping embargo enters third month.
{role:shipping_consortium} warns third-party haulers against entering restricted gate sectors.
Miner delegates in {system} denounce debt sanctions as manufactured starvation.

voice_direction.blockade_broker: Gravelly, weary, speaking with the grim determination of someone who knows the odds and refuses to quit. Avoids sentimental nostalgia.
voice_direction.cartel_commodore: Crisp, icy, delivering corporate ultimatums as though reciting basic navigation geometry. Never displays anger.
voice_direction.relief_coordinator: Exhausted, speaking in rapid, clipped sentences stripped of all emotion except triage arithmetic.
